hooks.description: Writes every hook event to the session-scoped workflow-telemetry.jsonl. Always runs, never blocks. Logging failures do not affect gate behaviour.
Blocks all file-write tool calls while the session manifest currentStep is 'dev-interview'. Enforces Plan mode structurally during S1.
Enforces the S1→S8 step progression. Before any step begins, checks that the prior step's required artifact exists in the phase directory.
Blocks S1 from starting until the phase Linear issue status is 'Approved'. Prevents build work beginning before Product Manager and Lead Dev have approved the phase.
Blocks S5 build from starting until all files listed in the phase's requiredReferences have been read in the current session (confirmed via read_file calls recorded in telemetry).
Blocks S5 build from starting until the developer has set validationConfirmed = true in the session manifest. This flag cannot be set by any agent or hook — only the developer can set it.

Blocks Dependent phase lanes from entering S5 until foundationVerified = true in the session manifest. Set by the orchestrator after all Foundation and Independent phases have merged and regression has passed.
In Checkpoint build mode only: blocks the next batch's build tool call until the developer has set batches[N].confirmed = true in the session manifest after reviewing the batch review document.
Blocks S6 code review from starting until the phase's phase-{N}-tdd-results.md file exists and contains 'STATUS: PASS'.
Blocks S7 agent testing from starting until the phase's code-review.md exists and contains 'Critical findings: 0'.
Fires on the stop event. Blocks the agent from ending its turn until the phase's test-results.md exists and contains 'STATUS: PASS'.
Fires on afterFileEdit. Detects new trigger files written to .skill-update-triggers/ by the Linear webhook receiver and fires the skill-effectiveness-evaluator apply step.
